title: Open comparison compatibility for the constructed restriction identifications
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S, g′:X′→X form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let U⊂X be open, j its inclusion, T=X′×X U, p:T→X′ and q:T→U the projections, and supply the induced pullback square. Fix z∈T and i∈ℤ and derived categories on all schemes. Let P be a K-flat complex of O_X-modules, with the specified pullback counit for g′ invertible, and let Q be its literal termwise restriction. Suppose the specified pullback counit for q at Q is invertible. Let a and b be the additive comparisonIntoPullback arrows for P and Q [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-pullback-naturality]. Use the constructed η=openDerivedStalkIso(p,z,i) and eQ=openRestrictionRepresentativeIso(j,P) [def-pc-open-derived-stalk-iso], and let β=openRestrictedCompositionMap(g′,U,DQ(P)) [def-pc-open-restricted-composition-map]. Let HU be the additive derived stalk cohomology at z. There exists an isomorphism l between the sources of a and b with a;η_(L(g′)*(DQ(P))) = l.hom;b;HU(Lq*(eQ.hom);β). The stalk identification and representative identification are fixed constructions: this statement does not construct η, quantify over an arbitrary represented K, or quantify over an arbitrary eQ.

proof.text: Use the ordinary comparison square on the literal restricted complex to obtain the source isomorphism l. This square ends in ordinary tensor-pullback representatives, before inverse derived pullback counits.

Apply the counit compatibility equation. Using the supplied invertible counits, cancel to obtain d.inv;Lp(inv epsilon_g)=inv epsilon_q;Lq(eQ.hom);beta. Apply additive stalk cohomology to this equality.

Naturality of the constructed eta for inv epsilon_g transports the ordinary square to the derived target. The local categorical helper assembles the equations; unfold comparisonIntoPullback and comparisonIntoTensorPullback to obtain exactly the unchanged canonical square. K-flatness is retained in the signature but is not needed by this reduction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_restricted_canonical_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (U : X.Opens)
    (sqU : IsPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f') (U.ι ≫ f) g)
    (z : (pullback g' U.ι : Scheme.{u})) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk (pullback.fst g' U.ι z)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let FU := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((pullback g' U.ι).presheaf.stalk z))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let HU := comparisonStalkCohomology (pullback g' U.ι) z i ⋙ FU
    ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
        (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
      ,
      let Q : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ :=
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      ∀ (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q))),
      let eQ := openRestrictionRepresentativeIso U.ι P
      let η := openDerivedStalkIso (pullback.fst g' U.ι) z i
      let a := F.map (comparisonIntoPullback f f' g g' sq
        (pullback.fst g' U.ι z) P hcP i)
      let b := FU.map (comparisonIntoPullback (U.ι ≫ f) (pullback.fst g' U.ι ≫ f')
        g (pullback.snd g' U.ι) sqU z Q hcQ i)
      let β := openRestrictedCompositionMap g' U (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
      ∃ l : (Arrow.mk a).left ≅ (Arrow.mk b).left,
        a ≫ η.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) =
          l.hom ≫ b ≫ HU.map ((derivedPullback (pullback.snd g' U.ι)).map eQ.hom ≫ β)
